normalized.result:
Live filtering feels quick and natural, and the match highlighting and result count are helpful. Search should ignore capitalisation.

Title, description, and address are the right starting point. The site name doesn’t need special treatment if it already appears in the address, but any notes I add to a bookmark should also be searchable.

For a larger collection, I’d also want a few precise searches: `#tag` to search by tag, quotation marks for an exact phrase, and `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, and parentheses for combinations. Those words should only act as search instructions when unquoted; if I put one in quotation marks, it should be searched as an ordinary word.
